summary: Pitstop phase selector (sub_4A55E0, legacy ABI name Conditional_Dispatch_4a55e0). Reads the selector flag at this[11] (offset 0x2C); when non-zero it calls PitstopStateTransition on this[4] (offset 0x10), otherwise on this[3] (offset 0xC). Returns the result of the selected transition.

operations.description: Read the selector flag this[11] (offset 0x2C): non-zero selects this[4], zero selects this[3].
When the flag is zero, advance the state machine with PitstopStateTransition(this[3]) using the candidate pointer at offset 0xC.
When the flag is non-zero, advance the state machine with PitstopStateTransition(this[4]) using the candidate pointer at offset 0x10.
Return the result of the selected PitstopStateTransition call; the selected call is not null-guarded.

Called from ArithmeticComparison_5660 (0x004A5660), UtilityFunction_5750 (0x004A5750), IndexDecrementWithBoundsWrap (0x004A57A0) and AIStateMachineWithModeDispatch (0x004A5D10) as a pitstop state phase selector.

unresolved: Whether this[11] is a boolean selector or a mode/state value is only evidenced as zero versus non-zero.
The pitstop state machine phases advanced by PitstopStateTransition are owned by the callee and not evidenced here.
